scope: Reference inventory and admission planning only; no price study or admission
selection_basis: Economic coverage, existing catalog and current primary-source listing metadata; no performance/AUM/yield selection
historical_eligibility: Prospective membership begins no earlier than verified admission and actual capture. Earlier research requires dated membership, mandate and availability evidence; inception alone is insufficient.
reference_rules: Local candidate IDs are permanent; ticker reuse creates a new identity.
Issuer product IDs are reference IDs, not globally certified security IDs.
One primary bucket plus secondary tags; no double counting silver or multi-region funds.
Unknown inception/closure/currency remains null. Directory absence is not closure evidence.
Mandate or index change splits dated regimes; do not silently join historical series.

admission_rules.identity: Reconcile issuer name, ISIN/CUSIP, listing MIC/currency/calendar, inception vs listing, splits/distributions, closure and mandate history; preserve existing holds.
admission_rules.price: Pinned published audited adjusted prices for returns; separately audited raw OHLC/volume for activity; complete causal lookback and no fills/substitutions.

liquidity.status: proposal frozen before outcome comparison; requires review before admission
liquidity.spread_note: Historical raw dollar-volume proxy does not certify historical spreads. Missing spreads block paper readiness, not falsely passed.
liquidity.no_AUM_gate: No current AUM survivorship screen. Review fund closure/liquidity risk independently.

admission_rules.warmup: 252 consecutive supported sessions after the verified mandate/listing boundary; new mandates restart warmup. Annual screening is not permission to fill missing history.
admission_rules.broker: Fresh contract, security type, primary venue, quote currency, min tick/size, order capabilities, account/environment permissions and reconciliation; no inventory field enables routing.
admission_rules.fx: USD quote does not remove underlying FX or CNH reporting FX requirements. Uncertified legacy FX remains disclosed.

duplicate_rules.status: Proposed conservative overlap buckets, not verified identical indexes or measured independent breadth
duplicate_rules.representative: After eligibility, choose highest prior-63-session audited median dollar volume, then lower contemporaneously documented fee if both known, then permanent candidate ID; never trailing return.
duplicate_rules.selection: At most one representative per duplicate review bucket for class ranking; swap only at scheduled rebalance, charge all turnover. Ineligible bucket stays absent.
duplicate_rules.breadth: Report fund count, bucket count, singleton buckets, holdings overlap and effective covariance breadth separately. Regional and global parents share exposure limits; they are not independent.
duplicate_rules.peer_minimum: No within-peer cross-sectional alpha claim with fewer than three independently supported exposure groups; do not count substitutes as independent observations.

proposed_risk_normalization.status: Frozen proposal for a later registered comparison; not calculated here
proposed_risk_normalization.formula: Mean over h in {21,63,126} of log(adjusted_close_t / adjusted_close_t_minus_h) / (sample_std_of_last_63_daily_log_returns * sqrt(h))
proposed_risk_normalization.rules: All inputs available at decision cutoff; require finite positive volatility and complete 127-price/63-return windows. One vote per eligible representative; equal-weight bucket scores within class. No missing-value imputation.
proposed_risk_normalization.baseline: First compare unchanged recipe on original versus full admitted pool. Risk normalization is a separate arm, never bundled with alpha or universe effects.
proposed_risk_normalization.unchanged: 126-session positive gate, monthly schedule, defensive fallback and 45% cap are not changed by inventory.

later_research_gates: P4.15 turnover/IC/dispersion gate before every replay; missing inputs means insufficient, not pass.
Freeze new time/group holdouts after the inspected historical sample and label retrospective evidence.
Family-adjusted tests and full-pool attribution; unchanged SOTA/FR25 comparators.
P6.15 measured worker budgets before concurrent expansion.
capacity_note: Illustrative allowance for files, replicas/snapshots and staging; excludes provider evidence, actions, filings, intraday data, models and backtest reports. Not measured ClickHouse compression.
next_stage: Review inventory and rules before recorder ingestion; this manifest cannot enable automatic admission, calculations or orders.
